_comment: Central configuration. Nothing in src/ hard-codes these values. Values marked PENDING must be supplied before Google Sheet sync can run; the rest of the app works without them.

googleSheet._comment: Either provide spreadsheetId (preferred) or the full sheet URL - the id is parsed out of the URL. Auth: service account via GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env. Without credentials the app falls back to the public CSV export endpoint, which needs the sheet shared as 'anyone with the link can view'.

columns._comment: Map application field -> Google Sheet column header (case-insensitive, trimmed). Alternatively use a column letter like "A", "B". Update here only - no code change required.

inactiveStatuses._comment: Spec rule 11: a disruption is ACTIVE unless its current status is one of these. Note 'Resolved by Dealer' is deliberately NOT here - per spec it stays ACTIVE.

report._comment: The hourly report splits active records into a main table and a secondary 'Auditing & Non-Admin' table. Statuses listed here render in the secondary table.

issueMaster._comment: PENDING - real Issue / Sub Issue master to be supplied. Keys are Issues, values are their Sub Issues. Replace this whole object; no code change required.
